posts.title: Making printable labels for your Discogs collection
posts.description: Lately I’ve come to realise that I’m fairly scatterbrained. I obsess over ideas monomaniacally, only to move on before finishing them. When the stars align, this focus leads to quick, tangible results. But usually I just end up with a mental backlog of half-finished projects. This has gotten worse since becoming a parent.
